statement: The full mapping-class congruence property is equivalent to trivial congruence kernel and cofinality of characteristic finite-quotient levels; it does not assert ambient normality.
notes: Topology/completion proof; finite C2⊂S3 illustrates the distinct logical question.

statement: Full CSP holds for hyperbolic genus0,1,2, including closed genus2, and for the finite permutation/orientation extensions.
notes: Boggi2009 Prop2.6,Thm2.8,Thm3.5; Boggi2020 Thm1.4(ii) is required for closed genus2. Current status checked against Boggi2026. These are imported established theorems, not newly proved here.

statement: CSP for general hyperbolic types of genus at least3 remains open; smallest unresolved instance (3,0).
notes: Literature-open problem. Puncturing does not change its kernel.

statement: The extended geometric image is a proper subgroup of full loop-preserving profinite Out for every hyperbolic type; the unrestricted 'always' claim fails for trivial fundamental groups.
notes: Cyclotomic multiplier proof; full exceptional-type analysis. Nontrivial homological congruence kernel for (1,0) has explicit finite PSL2(F8) witness, checked in code.

statement: The extended geometric group need not be normal in full loop-preserving Out, already at (0,3).
depends_on: D: faithful Galois action on the tripod
notes: S3×<complex conjugation> inside S3×G_Q; x^3−2 gives the finite S3 nonnormality witness. Distinct from oriented normality and the withdrawn self-normalizer conjecture.

statement: Conjugate geometric subgroups are O/N_O(Σ); the prediscretization fibers are torsors under N_O(Σ)/Σ; uniqueness is precisely normality.
notes: Elementary closed coset-space argument.

statement: Whether every unrestricted inertia-preserving automorphism normalizes the oriented geometric image is not resolved here; the first comparison is Σ=S3 in O_0,3.
notes: Open means unresolved in this audit, not a claim that all individual instances are classified as open in the literature. The full normalizer quotient and the arithmetic quotient are distinct.

statement: A discrete nonabelian free or closed orientable hyperbolic surface lattice is self-normalizing in its full profinite completion.
notes: Uses Paris2009 conjugacy separability and Grossman Property A as stated there, plus center-freeness. No priority claim.

statement: Restriction of actual based discretizations to any open subgroup is injective, with induced orientation and peripheral data.
notes: Proof for normal cover via lattice normalizer, then core; no CSP assumption.

statement: For a normal finite cover, a lattice extends uniquely iff its deck outer action comes from discrete orientation-preserving peripheral automorphisms.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan352: Π|π; displayed deck quotient π′/π; margin π′|π′_0
notes: Center-free extension construction; Kerckhoff1983 Thm7 supplies surface realization; Boggi–Zalesskii2019 Lem3.1 and Prop3.6 supply torsion-free and loop checks. Mathematical quotient must be π/π′.

statement: Restriction of actual discretizations along finite coverings need not be onto; a degree2 pants cover provides a counterexample.
notes: A nonopen centralizer gives an uncountable profinite conjugacy orbit; choose a conjugate deck action outside the countable discrete mapping class group. A nested-clopen specification is given. Finite partition check in code; closure prediscretizations are unchanged.

statement: Finite-cover restriction descends to strict and closure prediscretizations, oriented or unoriented.
notes: Uses π=VD and density on finite sets of open subgroups. Resolves well-definedness only, without proving bijectivity.

statement: Coset-map injectivity is exactly f^{-1}(B′)=B and surjectivity exactly A′=f(A)B′; normalizer quotient comparison needs the stated additional hypotheses.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan358: ambient double-hat C|single-hat C in normalizer
notes: Proof separates conditions (a)–(e) and does not assume a restriction homomorphism is onto.

statement: Unrestricted finite-cover prediscretization bijectivity remains unresolved here, with exact inverse-image and factorization conditions and a characteristic degree4 pants test.
notes: Open in this audit. Small noncharacteristic test is degree2 (0,4)→(0,3); characteristic mod2 test is (0,6)→(0,3). CSP in both types does not establish these full Out conditions.

statement: Raw based discretization injectivity under puncture filling is false already for (0,4)→(0,3).
notes: Distinct inner-conjugate lattices hDh^{-1},D with h=x^α and α nonintegral have the same filled image. CRT sanity checks attached; this does not refute either prediscretization assertion.

statement: Filling a Galois-stable set of punctures is quotient by closed normal geometric inertia and classifies finite étale covers extending across them.
notes: Arithmetic and geometric quotient maps, base-point ambiguity, and characteristic-zero hypotheses explicit.

statement: The full profinite Birman sequence is exact for hyperbolic target types, with kernel the completed point-pushing surface group.
notes: Completion injection follows from center-free inner action. Source hyperbolicity alone is insufficient; torus and twice-punctured-sphere failures explained.

statement: The procongruence Birman sequence is exact for every hyperbolic target, including closed targets, and has full profinite surface kernel.
notes: Boggi2020 Cor4.7 and Prop2.4(ii), with history in Remark4.8; older Boggi2009 Thm2.5 alone excludes closed targets.

statement: The congruence kernels C_g,n+1 and C_g,n are naturally isomorphic for each hyperbolic target.
notes: Explicit lifting/kernel diagram chase; no CSP assumed.

statement: The revised arithmetic-image quotient is canonically G_Q for every hyperbolic type; universal-monodromy kernel is precisely geometric congruence kernel.
depends_on: D: Hoshi–Mochizuki Cor6.4 and G_Q slimness
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan395 eq(4): omitted pure superscript on denominator
notes: Uses a curve over a finite number-field extension, then excludes a finite normal kernel. Does not assume all marked types have Q-points. No GT surjectivity or section conjecture used.

statement: The arithmetic-image filling sequence is exact and its arithmetic quotient map is canonically the identity of G_Q.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan399 eq(9): N|M; right arrow|double arrow
notes: Quotient arithmetic moduli Birman sequence by matching congruence kernels. Pure and unordered/stabilizer variants specified.

statement: A chosen cusp gives a well-defined continuous genuine-automorphism map from its outer stabilizer to Aut of the filled group.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan348: G target should be based automorphisms of π′
notes: Representatives preserving inertia differ by inner inertia, killed on filling. Choice of inertia representative gives stated inner ambiguity.

statement: The unrestricted double-hat exact sequence is equivalent to the based cusp map being an isomorphism and to oriented prediscretization filling bijectivity; it remains unresolved here.
depends_on_doubtful_reading: scan348 G|T and missing + in oriented denominator
notes: Exact missing conditions: full Out filling surjective and kernel exactly point-pushing π. First hyperbolic target test is (0,4)→(0,3). Open in this audit; not conflated with CSP.

statement: FC-admissible configuration automorphisms restrict injectively at every level and bijectively in the verified affine/proper ranges.
notes: Hoshi–Mochizuki2011 Thm6.1: map m+1→m injective m≥1, bijective m≥3 affine/m≥4 proper. TopicsI ThmA/Cor1.9 supplies F-to-FC implication from a higher lift. These are not arbitrary single-surface Out groups.

statement: The classifying topos of a curve's fundamental group is not its full small étale topos.
notes: Subterminal-object invariant: group-action topos has2; curve étale topos has all Zariski opens and thus at least3. No finite-cover/full-topos substitution.

statement: Over a fixed sub-p-adic field, an arithmetic hyperbolic curve group on the geometric essential image reconstructs the proper completion and its full étale topos, functorially for isomorphisms.
notes: Recover curve by relative Isom theorem, proper model by function field, then full site from opens in normalizations of all finite separable function-field extensions. Does not assert a recognition theorem for arbitrary extensions or reconstruct from bare geometric π.

statement: Over a field, deleting a rational point deletes exactly that point from the rational-point set and corresponding point-induced section classes.
notes: Only point-induced sections; no section-map surjectivity. Galois-stable deleted sets need not consist of individually rational points.

statement: For families, distinct sections can intersect, refuting the extension of the one-point deletion formula to arbitrary acting groups.
notes: Explicit constant family U×U→U, U=P1−{0,1,∞}, diagonal and constant2 sections meet at2. Matches author's later withdrawal; code checks intersection.
